# Packages

```{r}
library(tidyverse)
library(here)
source(here("R", "item-analysis.R"))
```

# Data

```{r}
long <- read_exam(params$exam)

long |>
  distinct(instructor, section_id, id) |>
  count(instructor, section_id, name = "students")
```

# Questions to Remove

Items where more than one answer was scored correct (regraded or credit given) and items some students saw twice.

```{r}
bad_items <- flag_bad_items(long)
bad_items |> count(exam, name = "n_removed")

clean <- long |>
  anti_join(bad_items, by = c("exam", "question_title"))
```

# Analysis

```{r}
results <- item_summary(clean)

chapter <- read_csv(here("data", "fall_spring_exams_1_3_chapters.csv"))

df <- results$items |>
  left_join(chapter, by = "question_title")
```

# Selecting Questions

## Keep questions with a discrimination index greater than or equal to 0.25

From Canvas: Lower discrimination scores are scored +0.24 or lower; good scores are +0.25 or higher.

```{r}
select_di <- df |>
  filter(discrimination_index >= 0.25) |>
  filter(if_all(starts_with("point_biserial_distractor_"), \(x) x < 0))

nrow(select_di)
```

## Comparison of Difficulty

```{r}
y_max <- ggplot_build(
  ggplot(df, aes(difficulty_index)) + geom_histogram(bins = 30)
)$data[[1]]$count |>
  max()

plot_difficulty(df, "All retained items", y_max)
plot_difficulty(select_di, "Items with discrimination index ≥ 0.25", y_max)
```

# Distribution of Chapters that Questions Come from

```{r}
plot_chapters(df, params$chapter_subtitle)
plot_chapters(select_di, params$chapter_subtitle)
```

# Combined DF

```{r}
df_questions <- results$options |>
  left_join(df, by = c("exam", "question_title")) |>
  select(-starts_with("point_biserial_correct"), -starts_with("point_biserial_distractor_"))

write_excel_csv(
  df_questions,
  here("data", "spring", paste0(params$exam, "_combined.csv")),
  na = ""
)
```
